title: Measuring an initial rate
caption: The initial rate is the gradient of the concentration–time curve at t = 0. Draw the tangent at the start and measure its gradient: here 0.2 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹. Repeating with different starting concentrations gives the orders.
alt: Product concentration against time, a curve levelling at 0.8, with a dashed tangent at the origin of gradient 0.2.
description: The curve rises and levels off at 0.8 mol dm⁻³.
The tangent at t = 0 rises 0.4 in 2 min: initial rate 0.2 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹.

checks.name: the curve's gradient at t = 0 is 0.2 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹
and the tangent drawn has that gradient
